title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Robinhood says its AI agent feature will ‘soon’ be assisting crypto traders
summary: More than 70,000 agentic accounts have already been created by Robinhood equities and options traders since late May, when Robinhood launched a beta version of the product.

title: DOJ moves to dismiss charges against alleged $722M BitClub fraudster: Report
summary: Matthew Goettsche was set to face trial in October for conspiracy to commit wire fraud and selling unregistered securities.

title: Kraken to overhaul app with AI investing assistant
summary: The redesigned app will use AI to recommend trades and tailor investing tools around users' financial goals as Kraken expands into broader financial services.

title: Senate Democrats call for hearings into Trump’s ties to crypto amid CLARITY Act discussions
summary: Five senators called for committee hearings to investigate US President Donald Trump’s policies potentially being influenced by crypto funding from United Arab Emirates-linked and other entities.

title: US CBDC ban to go into effect without Trump signoff on housing bill
summary: Donald Trump confirmed on social media that he would not sign the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, which includes a ban on a US CBDC until the end of 2030, setting the stage for the bill to become law on Saturday.

title: New Hampshire council votes down $100M Bitcoin bonds
summary: State representative Keith Ammon said the New Hampshire executive council's vote against Bitcoin-backed bonds was “short-sighted,” urging the body to reconsider the measure.

title: Backpack joins race for 24/7 stock markets with tokenized equities
summary: The launch comes as tokenized stocks become one of the fastest-growing corners of crypto, with exchanges and traditional finance firms racing to expand 24/7 trading.

title: Crypto Biz: How stablecoins found their niche
summary: Stablecoins are carving out specialized roles as regulation reshapes the market, while Strategy’s Bitcoin sale and Vanguard’s tokenization push highlight crypto’s evolving financial landscape.

title: Bitcoin whales sent BTC price to $64K as Coinbase Premium broke key level: CryptoQuant
summary: Bitcoin price gains came thanks to US whales propeling the Coinbase Premium above a key trend line, new analysis from CryptoQuant reported.
